Name: Milkable Sheep
Author: radmaninoff
Description:
uses selph's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]extra animal configs[/url] to add custom dairy produce to the basegame sheep! currently in development, but entirely playable.

[size=2]FEATURES:[/size]
[list]
[*]sheep now produce milk and wool on [b]alternate days[/b]
[*]milking adult sheep produces [b]sheep's milk[/b]! high friendship yields large sheep's milk, as in basegame
[*]pop your sheep's milk into a cheese press to make [b]sheep's cheese[/b]
[*]alternate milk sprites to match popular retexture mods (i.e. the ones i like LOL)! configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿
[*]the cheese is ageable (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642]Custom Cask Mod[/url]﻿)!
[/list][size=2]INSTALLATION:[/size]
[list]
[*]install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]﻿
[*]unzip this mod directly into your mods folder (or buried under a couple of subfolders, like i do!)
[*]boot up and enjoy!
[/list][size=2]UNINSTALLATION:[/size]
[list]
[*]drag this baby out of your mods folder. that's it!
[*]your sheep may still produce error items when you reopen your save. they should be back to normal after you "shear" them and go to sleep, and the error items can be safely thrown away or sold for a clean uninstall!
[/list][size=2]COMPAT/KNOWN ISSUES[/size]
[url=https://smapi.io/log]submit a log[/url]﻿ if you run into any bugs not listed here. thank you for helping make this mod better!
[list]
[*]partially compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/859]better ranching[/url]﻿. turn off "Prevent Failed Harvesting" to run both mods in the same game.
[/list][size=2]MODS PICTURED:[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]lookup anything[/url]﻿
[*]cjb item spawner
[/list][size=2]CREDITS:[list]
[*]original cheese pixel: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/PixelArt/comments/su2ups/food_items_16x16/]Scilex[/url]﻿ on reddit ﻿
[*]alternate milk pixels match these mods:
[/list][/size][size=2][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394] ﻿cometkins' better artisan goods[/url]﻿ (made by the lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/21934209]LilietBorodina[/url])[/size][/size]
[size=2][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12766][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2] ﻿aimon111's [/size][/size][/size][/size]fancy artisan goods[/url]﻿﻿ (which in turn are based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2494]andiluxe's glass milk bottles[/url]﻿!)[/size][/size]
[size=2][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6522] ﻿badmoonbase's milk bottles and cans[/url]﻿[/size][/size]
